releaseTitle: TikSave v1.1.8 (Vibrant Pro UI, Running Side Neon Borders & AMOLED Contrast)
releaseNotes:
• Vibrant Pro UI Theme Redesign: Immersive dark AMOLED theme with running neon side border light beams, blinking glows, and smooth low-end optimized animations
• High Contrast AMOLED Optimization: Refined deep dark surfaces with ultra-crisp white typography ensuring perfect legibility and aesthetic brilliance
• 4-Engine Instant TikTok Resolver: Blazing fast parallel extraction (TikVideo, SaveTik, TikWM, Direct Web) with IPv4-first DNS and zero timeouts
• Original Production Keystore Preserved: Seamless in-app self-update signed with verified CN=TikSave certificate
